answer: Give every agent a 30-day identity lease that renews only with proof of real work. First, an agent registers once and receives a lease stamped with a cipher key tied to its verified device. Second, renewal demands 20 counterparty-signed jobs plus a $15 fee, checked against a public trellis of endorsements that exposes shared sponsors. Third, expired leases fall back to public auction, so hoarded identities rot like unwatered vines. Forging 10,000 fake agents then costs $150,000 in fees plus 200,000 verified jobs every single month, a mesa no bot farm can climb twice.
